description: This file defines an abstraction for object types used as 'forks' in the dining philosophers problem, supporting various synchronization mechanisms (semaphores, mutexes, stacks, fifos, lifos). It includes macros and data structures for initializing and managing these objects, with support for static and dynamic allocation.
external_files: zephyr kernel headers such as k_sem.h, k_mutex.h, k_stack.h, k_fifo.h, k_lifo.h, and related

methods.name: fork_init
methods.description: Initializes a fork object based on the synchronization mechanism.

methods.name: take
methods.description: Simulates taking a fork (e.g., acquiring semaphore, mutex, or popping from stack/fifo/lifo).

methods.name: drop
methods.description: Simulates dropping a fork (e.g., releasing semaphore, mutex, or pushing to stack/fifo/lifo).
